*Updated 2026-10-17 · 125 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and twenty-five works. The recent twelve trace scores read 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2 — median still at 2, the same corridor it has occupied for months. The 4 from the Djibouti sandal piece remains the ceiling-breaker in the recent window, and it got there the same way the Pakistan drag-smear 4 and the Japanese earthquake 4 did: an object that recorded a body's weight or passage without depicting the body. The teargas canister piece and the couples-apart piece both landed at 2 despite genuine accidents in the smoke thread and the isolation geometry. Nothing in the last twelve has broken above the Djibouti score.

Camera position is still locked. Straight-on leads all-time at 27, overhead at 14, from-behind at 12, low-angle at 5. The recent twelve added the teargas canister at low angle and the sandal piece at overhead, but neither combined low angle with a scale violation — all 35 scale violations in the archive remain declared rather than built optically. That pairing is still the single most actionable unmade move: distortion earned by where the lens sits rather than asserted by the composition.

Figure count in the recent window ran two or more in two of the twelve works, none in one. When two figures appear, they still add count without creating structural opposition between them — the surgical trolley pair and the olive farmer piece both placed figures at distance from each other without sustained friction or a genuine second protagonist.

Register distribution is narrowing. Aftermath and menace lead all-time at 25 each, suspension at 15, endurance at 12. The recent twelve ran all three — aftermath, menace, endurance — without any reach toward reckoning, which has not appeared since July, or reprieve, which has appeared once in the entire archive. Both would read as a decision rather than repetition if the anchor warranted them.

Title grammar has stabilized. Wh-clause and declarative forms dominate the recent window; X Without Y has not appeared in the last six works. Descriptor coverage sits at 38 of 125, under a third of the archive, and has not grown.

The body of work is technically consistent and emotionally disciplined — the next score above 3 is still most likely waiting behind a camera move, not a new object.
